verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no feature for exporting user data such as chat history or sessions in open formats. Local-only execution ("no cloud, no data sharing") and GGUF model support are adjacent properties, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
